title: Vera answers operator questions in admin with live numbers, read only and staff only

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-03 16:38Z (an Admin and Web Assistant that answers any question about functions and settings), 2026-11-04 06:13Z (approved to get this done) and 13:26Z (Admin Assistant scope: answers plus confirmed changes); Vera assistants plan /mnt/project-files/vera-assistants-2026-11-03/REPORT.md, phase V4.

detail:
Vera already spoke operator to operator for staff but had no live figures, so she pointed at /admin for every number. Now a staff caller's chat carries an admin_lookup read tool over a closed list of questions (lib/ai/vera/admin-questions.ts): live Spaces without a published website, Spaces created in the last 7 days, people who joined in the last 7 days, moderation reports waiting, and open support tickets. Each id maps to one fixed read-only query (lib/ai/vera/admin-lookups.ts); there is no free-form query, an unknown id reads nothing, and member names never leave the lookup. The turn hands the lookup in only when the caller's own session is staff, the agent offers the tool only then, each run re-reads the session before it reads, and the model chokepoint answers an invented call on any other turn with nothing read. A failed read is a plain line pointing at the admin page.

Shipped: admin-questions.ts, admin-lookups.ts, the admin_lookup tool and OPERATOR_TOOL_KEYS in tools.ts, the chokepoint branch in model-tools.ts, the gating in agent-claude.ts and turn.ts, tests and probe.
